description: A trust account statement issued by a trustee or trust company, showing balance and distributions. Used to verify trust-fund asset value.

trustee_name.instruction: The name of the trustee or trust company administering the trust.

beneficiary_name.instruction: The full name of the trust beneficiary.

account_number.instruction: The unique account number assigned to the trust account.

trust_type.instruction: The type of trust, such as revocable, irrevocable, or testamentary.

statement_period_start.instruction: Start of the statement period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

statement_period_end.instruction: End of the statement period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

account_balance.instruction: The trust account balance or corpus value as reported on the statement.

distributions_during_period.instruction: The total amount distributed from the trust during the statement period, if any.
